meta.name: Diagnose failed n8n workflows with Claude and Gmail alerts

name: Alert & Diagnose failed n8n workflows with Claude and email the fix

parameters.content:
## Diagnose any failed workflow with AI

Set this workflow as the Error Workflow on everything else you run. When any of them fails, this one catches it, works out what actually broke in plain English, and emails you the cause and the fix instead of a stack trace.

### How it works
The Error Trigger receives the failed execution and a Code node pulls out the workflow, the node that broke, the error type, the message and a trimmed stack. It then checks whether this exact failure already alerted you recently, because alert storms are why people switch error notifications off. Repeats inside your cooldown window are counted and suppressed rather than resent. Anything new goes to one AI call that rates severity, decides whether the error is transient or real, names the likely cause and returns up to four concrete steps to take inside n8n. You get a readable email with a link to the failed run. If the model returns nothing usable, the raw error is sent anyway, so an alert is never swallowed.

### Setup
- Edit the config node: the address to alert and the cooldown in minutes.
- Add credentials: Anthropic on the diagnosis node, Gmail on the send node.
- In every other workflow, open Settings and set Error Workflow to this one. That is the whole install.

### Customization
Route critical failures to the optional Slack node on the canvas, log every failure to Google Sheets to see which node breaks most, or drop transient errors so only real faults reach you.

Built by **nocode.expert**, done-for-you automation and AI workflows. https://nocode.expert/resources/n8n-error-handling

## 1. Catch the failure
The Error Trigger fires for any workflow that names this one as its Error Workflow. Nothing to wire up in the other workflows beyond that one setting.

## 2. Suppress repeat alerts
The same failure inside your cooldown window is counted, not resent. A workflow failing every minute sends one email, not sixty.

## 3. Diagnose it
One AI call rates severity, decides if the error is transient, and returns concrete steps to take inside n8n.

## 4. Tell you
A readable email with the cause, the fix and a link to the failed run. If the model returns nothing usable, the raw error still goes out.

## Optional: add your own routes
The Slack node below is deliberately not connected. Wire it after the formatter to push critical failures to a channel as well as to email, or swap it for Telegram, Discord or a Google Sheets log.
